summary_full: In recent times, there has been a notable drop in family consent rates for organ donation in the UK, resulting in an unprecedented number of patients on transplant waiting lists. To combat this issue, NHS Blood and Transplant has initiated a campaign aimed at boosting registration among potential donors. Menna Owen's experience serves as a poignant reminder that having clear donation preferences can provide solace and ultimately save lives.
